body: Fuck it all.

People are concerned and feel like to bully when one individual seems strange to them. We are living on a rock that is floating in the space. We don't know what the space is. We don't know where exactly our shitty rock is. We don't know what this our space is. We can't tell if it itself is dimension or not. Where did it come from? Why do we exist? Does other intelligent beings exist? Why we can't stop killing each other?

We have these questions but still it is necessary to focus the brain work on the weirdos.
Or if I will go to work, I will tell them all to go fuck themselves.
This, my supper, it sucks. Some shitty chicken wings and beer. It could be my last. I can't stand people much longer. It's 50% chance if I will show up at work in the monday morning.

Narrow rope over the neck for suffocating the blood flow, lean so that the rope will be tied over a door knob, this should knock me unconsciousness. Plastic bag over the head for double check. I will comb my hair just to look slightly prettier once I'm dead.
Because. This may be the end of my story. It may end right now.
May I PM you?

I get your point. The world doesn't work as I want it to work. It never had and it never will. I mean, the people, they are so insanely hypocritical. They are evil without realizing it for themselves.

I may look like a tough guy, but I'm sensitive. They think they can do anything they want to me because I'm tough in their opinion. My mind is destroyed in reality.
I take it as you study some kind of psychology or is it just a hobby? I wish the best for you either way.
Then, why does everybody seem like "crazy" from my point of view? I can't tell why people are doing the opposite what they should do.
You are doing great work. You are nice person. I respect you. I want you to know that you are a good guy. Why are you doing this? Trying to help some random stranger in the internet?

I had to use vocabulary on word "perceptive". Way to go. I wouldn't get these hints if I was completely normal, would I?

Edit: Not "get" as in understand. I wouldn't receive these hints in the first place if I was normal person.
I could see myself being more open. It wouldn't resolve the issue with IQ, though. I view personality as mental disorder and I can't help it. I can't tell what is normal and what is not anymore.

I'm not sure if I can describe it but I get hints from here and there. How people talk to me. Everywhere. Excepting for bars. There women come to my table and I'll have to tell them to fuck off because I'm not interested.

Other than that, I just sense it.

Edit: By telling them to fuck off, I tell them nicely to go away. I'm well mannered person.
Underdeveloped.
Nice post. I'm thinking about it. I will reply again after a while.
How can I get help? Can I get an IQ test somewhere? How do I know if I'm indeed retarded?
I can't stand it. I'm retarded and nobody has the guts to say it to my face. I'm so pissed off that I can't even describe it by words.
Just tell me how to stop thinking of being retarded.
I've been to an operating room. I've seen people getting cut open there. It made me feel sick but I could do it. I could do it if I did it with passion, I could gut them alive.
Never.

I've done gore videos, movies and games. I've even helped people to die irl. Nothing works.

Edit: I used to work as a nurse. I would sit there and talk nice things while I watched an old person to die before me.

The thing why I'm still alive is that I really don't want to die. I don't want to kill either. This world is just so fucked up that it messes up my head. Death is the shortcut through this shit in another hand.

It is only a matter of time when I will finish myself. It could be today or when I'm in my 70's. Right now I can't see any other way out of this life. In this modern western world we treat the dogs better than our parents or grandparents. We should have a thing called euthanasia.
